newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finn learns hazards of motorway parking.
newsitem.headline: Finn learns hazards of motorway parking.

text.p: A Finnish motorist who left his car illegally parked on a motorway when he ran out of fuel returned from a petrol station to find the vehicle totally wrecked after three trucks had smashed into it, police said on Thursday.

The destruction began when one truck could not swerve to avoid the Opel Ascona, ran over it and tossed it in front of another truck. The second truck ploughed into the car and pushed it in front of a third which battered it off the motorway.
"The car was completely smashed...but nobody was hurt," a police officer told Reuters. The 20-year-old driver was given a parking ticket.
